topic: Task assignment process review and refinement
summary_markdown: The group discussed the current practice of assigning tasks to multiple people, which is causing notification spam. It was noted that tasks often appear without a clear owner, leading to multiple assignments. One participant suggested establishing a rule: if there is no single responsible person for a task, it should not be assigned to any individual. Another participant mentioned using an existing manager (Tolia) and the current practice of assigning every task to everyone involved. A decision was made regarding setting up notification filters to reduce spam.
decisions: Implement filtering settings to minimize task-related notifications.
action_items: Review and refine the process for assigning tasks to ensure a single responsible owner when possible.
